binary64AuthorityCounterexample.name: binary64-endpoint-relocation-authority-counterexample
binary64AuthorityCounterexample.result: Different partitions produce different authoritative binary64 wallet projections and different floor(D/2). This is an expected counterexample, not a test failure.
binary64AuthorityCounterexample.contract: At each adopted segment endpoint, project stock using stored + rate * (now - mark), capped. Only when endpoint >= 12000, settle that projection and reset both now and mark to 0. Do not retain absolute now after relocation.
